title: PersonaGym: Evaluating Persona Agents and LLMs

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.1: "We use GPT-4 O (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) for: (1) selecting persona-relevant environments, (2) generating task-specific questions"; also one of two "Evaluator Models" (judge) alongside LLAMA-3-70B

prompt.location: Sec 4.1 + Appendix A.4 (evaluation rubric/criteria referenced, following Liu et al. 2023)
prompt.note: GPT-4o is the environment/question generator and judge, not one of the seven benchmarked persona-agent models (Llama-2-13B/70B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-3-8B, DeepSeek-V3, GPT3.5, Claude 3 Haiku, GPT4.1, GPT4.5, Claude 3.5 Sonnet).

claim.metric: none isolated to GPT-4o (Table 3 correlation scores are for GPT-3.5/Llama-2-13B/Llama-2-70B PersonaScore vs. human judgment, using GPT-4o+Llama-3-70B jointly as the scoring ensemble)
claim.location: Table 3 (100 sampled personas); no per-judge breakdown isolating GPT-4o

data.source: PersonaGym benchmark, released under MIT license

notes: GPT-4o's own judging/generation quality is never isolated from the co-judge Llama-3-70B or reported as a standalone figure. The benchmarked subject models are entirely different LLMs (GPT4.1/GPT4.5/Claude/Llama/DeepSeek), none pinned to a live snapshot in this CSV row.
